decisions.reason: Certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line is close to the core portfolio and was launched only a year ago, so management will attribute any slow uptake to temporary market ramp-up and stay committed to its investment in certification.
The marine box cooler line is publicly tied to a claimed major market share in water cooling, which makes it highly visible and central to the firm's marine positioning.
The marine cooling unit has its own dedicated page and complements the marine cooler offering, so the visible commitment and strategic fit argue for persistence.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established know-how and represents multi-model development investment that management will justify by continuing it.
The finned tube for air coolers is a core component of the firm's exchanger offer, has a dedicated page, and supports internal production, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
The enhanced heat exchanger tubes embody the firm's R&D and efficiency claims, are prominently presented, and fit the announced innovation direction, so the firm keeps them.
